request.head: opt/python-inventory-capture
request.title: feat(index): opt-in bounded Python inventory capture and admission
request.body:
现有 config-only capture 无法证明完整 source inventory。新增 opt-in `cc_index::project_model::python_inventory::capture_python_declarations`：单一显式 owner/EntireProject、空 exclusions，Linux descriptor-relative 有界完整 regular-file 枚举/bytes capture，复用实际 Loader/provenance、同源 AST 和 borrowed DeclarationSnapshot 显式 limits。默认/partial/unsupported scope/config、symlink/nonregular/native/portable alias/hardlink、观察到的 drift 都 typed refusal；保存全部 raw config/evidence，绑定 marker absence/collision 和 full content，限制 aggregate output，返回前重检。

Fixed product: `8d2b312c066f0514fb5cee555767955bf34708d0`。基线 PR138 delivery `ba6197771da5425166fb0386d46c74f4a05e8273` / reviewed product `50a4933e48ef20b16401ac8f75c386a660aa8e5c`；无冲突原样 cherry-pick docs-only `bf1e47ee1a355ef2634761a980546492fe877f7b`，只在权威 tasks.json 添加新 notes 并生成 TODO，192 tasks 与 parent states 不变。

验证：官方 Rust1.95、原 Cargo.lock、--locked，91 passed / 0 failed / 0 ignored（新9 integration + 1 deterministic drift，原focused81）；strict scoped Clippy、fmt、committed-range diff 和 generator no-argument check 通过。新 fixtures 均自编真实临时文件系统，测试 exact/one-over count/bytes/depth/path/aggregate output。完整命令、logs 和源码 SHA256：`artifacts/checkpoints/python-inventory-capture-20261004/validation.json`；契约：`docs/internals/python-inventory-capture-v1.md`。

Linux-only，要求 statx mount ID；未实际执行 bind-mount fixture，不声称 OS-atomic/hostile mutation+restore、hardRSS、release/规模认证。仅内存 API，仍待独审；persistence/cache/versioned ingestion/publication guard/DB/MCP/retrieval 协议未接线。旧 qname/UID/extraction/search 和 model/parser implementation 不变。未运行 publicDEV/100k/holdout/第三方项目代码或 excluded post_index/broad/private42/GCWALfaults。无 merge/deploy。
